messages:
Lydia: Heads-up from Azure Marketplace & our SI partner: they want a security evidence pack for the joint SI integration. Items requested: SOC2 attestation (shareable page), redacted pen-test exec summary, vendor questionnaire, SBOM (container images), code-signing/HSM key policy attestation, and a short note about key rotation cadence. Can someone take point?
Tom: I can assemble. Which SOC2 artifact is the safe one to share?
Vik: Use SOC2_TypeII_2025-06_attestation.pdf in s3://redwood-sec/reports/. Share only the attestation page + auditor letter. Strip any PII.
Sam: I'll handle the code-signing attestation. We use AWS KMS + CloudHSM for the signing keys. I can export the signing cert thumbprint and a one-paragraph policy: key owners, rotation cadence (90 days), and HSM-backed usage.
Lydia: SI also specifically asked for an SBOM summary (they don't want the full CycloneDX JSON). A CSV with package name, version, source, and license is fine. Vik can you generate that?
Vik: Yes. Command I'll run locally to extract image SBOM and produce CSV:
```
syft packages docker:registry.redwood.ai/inference:prod-2026-03 -o cyclonedx-json=sbom.json
python scripts/sbom_to_csv.py sbom.json sbom_summary.csv
aws s3 cp sbom_summary.csv s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
```
Tom: Good. Legal check on pentest: do we need a separate NDA or can we send a redacted exec summary? @LegalBot
LegalBot: Existing partner NDA covers sharing attestations only. For penetration test artifacts, provide a redacted executive summary (remove vuln identifiers, IPs, customer data). Do NOT share raw logs or full reports. Include this attestation line: "Raw pentest artifacts withheld per Redwood policy."
ComplianceBot: Azure Marketplace intake also requested evidence of software integrity: code signing cert thumbprint and a hash list (SHA256) of the release binaries. Provide a signed manifest if possible.
Sam: I can produce signed_manifest.json with filenames and SHA256 hashes and a note that signing was done with HSM-backed KMS key alias alias/redwood/signing. Will redact internal build IDs.
Lydia: Perfect. Timeline: can we have everything staged by Thursday COB so we can upload Friday morning?
Tom: Yes. Plan: 1) Vik SBOM CSV, 2) Tom pulls SOC2 attestation + fills vendor questionnaire, 3) Sam code-sign attestation + signed manifest, 4) Draft redacted pentest exec summary.
Vik: I'll also include a short validation note that images were scanned with Trivy v0.45 and no critical packages were present in the listed images.
Sam: Command I'll use to stage artifacts to the secure bucket (internal only):
```
aws s3 cp SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
aws s3 cp pentest_exec_summary_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
aws s3 cp sbom_summary.csv s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
aws s3 cp signed_manifest.json s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
aws s3 cp code_signing_attestation.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/azure-siem/1775001234/
```
AzurePortalBot: Reminder: Uploads to Azure partner portal should be done via the portal UI only for sensitive docs. Do not post presigned S3 links in this channel. Use secure-share to grant access if portal ingestion is delayed.
Tom: Noted. We'll stage in s3 and then upload via the portal. No public links.
LegalBot: Also include a one-line confirmation about SBOM sensitivity: "SBOM summary omits full internal paths and build metadata; full SBOM withheld per policy."
Lydia: Thanks. I'll coordinate the portal submission and contact the SI to confirm they accept the CSV SBOM and the HSM attestation. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
